name: Agency Check
description: Hosted second-look check for AI agents. Before an agent buys, sends, books, shares, signs up, or connects an app, it calls agency_check with what it is about to do and gets back Ready, Pause, or Clarify with a plain-language reason (for example, the user named one recipient but the send goes to 214 people). Also offers describe_ruleset, explain_rule, and get_receipt. Sign in with Google via OAuth; the Free plan includes 20 checks a month with no card.
author: Cyber Strategy Institute
